fieldValues.statement: A brief calls a command over deciding in prose
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless no command exists yet: then the brief names the issue that will add it, and the step stays manual.
fieldValues.context: routines and .claude/commands run `clerk <cmd>` and act on its output. Evidence: six briefs sourced pr-upkeep.sh to compute pause and budget themselves, until clerk group-state (clerk#90).
